'''Abraxin''' was a misty [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]], within the [[Indrexu Spiral]] [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]]. It had a dubious reputation among the [[Tionese/Legends|Tionese]] due to its [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[marsh haunt]]s and its "[[Witch/Legends|witchy]]" [[Poet/Legends|poets]] and soothsayers. However, it was known for its [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverages, such as [[Abraxin Brandy]] and [[Abraxin beer|beer]].

==Description==
Abraxin was a misty [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Xim Week" /> in the [[Abraxin system/Legends|Abraxin system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> located within a fold of the [[Indrexu Spiral]], a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] within the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]]<ref name="Xim Week" /> in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]'s [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region.<ref name="EAOC" /> It was terrestrial, with a breathable (Type I) [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], and possessed at least one large dark [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] that was itself [[Homeworld/Legends|home]]<ref name="Plagueis" /> to the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] creature called the [[marsh haunt]].<ref name="CSWE Abraxin" /> The planet also possessed [[Tree/Legends|trees]] and [[Insect/Legends|insects]].<ref name="Plagueis" />

==History==
Abraxin had a dubious reputation among the [[Tionese/Legends|Tionese]], due to scary stories about the marsh haunt which were told to [[Youngling/Legends|children]] within the Tion Hegemony. These children then grew up to learn about the [[Poet/Legends|poets]] and soothsayers of Abraxin who were considered "[[Witch/Legends|witchy]]." Despite this reputation, it was known for its [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]],<ref name="Xim Week" /> which included [[Abraxin Brandy]] and at least one type of [[Abraxin beer|beer]].<ref name="Plagueis" />

During the lifetime of [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], Abraxin was aligned with [[Skere Kaan|Lord Kaan's]] [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] and was strong in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. However, this power had waned signficantly by the time of [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]].<ref name="Plagueis" />

At some point, a group of [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] made their way to the world and created a small [[Unidentified Barabel settlement|settlement]] on the edge of the planet's swamps, far from any [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]]. Circa [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Naat Lare]] visited Abraxin in order to hunt [[marsh haunt]]s, as an aspect of his [[Sith training|training]]. As an escapee from the [[Bedlam Institution for the Criminally Demented]], Lare was separately hunted by both Darth Plagueis and two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], [[Ni-Cada]] and [[Lo Bukk]]. The three ended up in the Barabel settlement, and Plagueis made contact with Lare and ordered him to kill the Jedi to prove himself. Lare failed, and was slain by Ni-Cada.<ref name="Plagueis" />
